class.name: OcgBndBox
class.brief_description: Describes a bounding box in 3D space. A bounding box is parallel to the axes of the coordinates system. If it is finite, it is defined by the three intervals: - [ Xmin,Xmax ], - [ Ymin,Ymax ], - [ Zmin,Zmax ]. A bounding box may be infinite (i.e. open) in one or more directions. It is said to be: - OpenXmin if it is infinite on the negative side of the "X Direction"; - OpenXmax if it is infinite on the positive side of the "X Direction"; - OpenYmin if it is infinite on the negative side of the "Y Direction"; - OpenYmax if it is infinite on the positive side of the "Y Direction"; - OpenZmin if it is infinite on the negative side of the "Z Direction"; - OpenZmax if it is infinite on the positive side of the "Z Direction"; - WholeSpace if it is infinite in all six directions. In this case, any point of the space is inside the box; - Void if it is empty. In this case, there is no point included in the box. A bounding box is defined by: - six bounds (Xmin, Xmax, Ymin, Ymax, Zmin and Zmax) which limit the bounding box if it is finite, - eight flags (OpenXmin, OpenXmax, OpenYmin, OpenYmax, OpenZmin, OpenZmax, WholeSpace and Void) which describe the bounding box if it is infinite or empty, and - a gap, which is included on both sides in any direction when consulting the finite bounds of the box.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an empty Box. The constructed box is qualified Void. Its gap is null.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a bounding box, it contains: - minimum/maximum point of bounding box, The constructed box is qualified Void. Its gap is null.

method.name: SetWhole
method.description: Sets this bounding box so that it covers the whole of 3D space. It is infinitely long in all directions.

method.name: SetVoid
method.description: Sets this bounding box so that it is empty. All points are outside a void box.

method.name: Set_1
method.description: Sets this bounding box so that it bounds - the point P. This involves first setting this bounding box to be void and then adding the point P.

method.name: Set_2
method.description: Sets this bounding box so that it bounds the half-line defined by point P and direction D, i.e. all points M defined by M=P+u*D, where u is greater than or equal to 0, are inside the bounding volume. This involves first setting this box to be void and then adding the half-line.

method.name: Update_2
method.description: Enlarges this bounding box, if required, so that it contains at least: - interval [ aXmin,aXmax ] in the "X Direction", - interval [ aYmin,aYmax ] in the "Y Direction", - interval [ aZmin,aZmax ] in the "Z Direction";

method.name: Update_1
method.description: Adds a point of coordinates (X,Y,Z) to this bounding box.

method.name: GetGap
method.description: Returns the gap of this bounding box.

method.name: SetGap
method.description: Set the gap of this bounding box to abs(Tol).

method.name: Enlarge
method.description: Enlarges the box with a tolerance value. (minvalues-Abs(<tol>) and maxvalues+Abs(<tol>)) This means that the minimum values of its X, Y and Z intervals of definition, when they are finite, are reduced by the absolute value of Tol, while the maximum values are increased by the same amount.

method.name: Get
method.description: Returns the bounds of this bounding box. The gap is included. If this bounding box is infinite (i.e. "open"), returned values may be equal to +/- Precision::Infinite(). Standard_ConstructionError exception will be thrown if the box is void. if IsVoid()

method.name: CornerMin
method.description: Returns the lower corner of this bounding box. The gap is included. If this bounding box is infinite (i.e. "open"), returned values may be equal to +/- Precision::Infinite(). Standard_ConstructionError exception will be thrown if the box is void. if IsVoid()

method.name: CornerMax
method.description: Returns the upper corner of this bounding box. The gap is included. If this bounding box is infinite (i.e. "open"), returned values may be equal to +/- Precision::Infinite(). Standard_ConstructionError exception will be thrown if the box is void. if IsVoid()

method.name: OpenXmin
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Xmin direction.

method.name: OpenXmax
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Xmax direction.

method.name: OpenYmin
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Ymin direction.

method.name: OpenYmax
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Ymax direction.

method.name: OpenZmin
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Zmin direction.

method.name: OpenZmax
method.description: The Box will be infinitely long in the Zmax direction.

method.name: IsOpen
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box has at least one open direction.

method.name: IsOpenXmin
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Xmin direction.

method.name: IsOpenXmax
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Xmax direction.

method.name: IsOpenYmin
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Ymix direction.

method.name: IsOpenYmax
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Ymax direction.

method.name: IsOpenZmin
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Zmin direction.

method.name: IsOpenZmax
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is open in the Zmax direction.

method.name: IsWhole
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is infinite in all 6 directions (WholeSpace flag).

method.name: IsVoid
method.description: Returns true if this bounding box is empty (Void flag).

method.name: IsXThin
method.description: true if xmax-xmin < tol.

method.name: IsYThin
method.description: true if ymax-ymin < tol.

method.name: IsZThin
method.description: true if zmax-zmin < tol.

method.name: IsThin
method.description: Returns true if IsXThin, IsYThin and IsZThin are all true, i.e. if the box is thin in all three dimensions.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Returns a bounding box which is the result of applying the transformation T to this bounding box. Warning Applying a geometric transformation (for example, a rotation) to a bounding box generally increases its dimensions. This is not optimal for algorithms which use it.

method.name: Add_1
method.description: Adds the box <Other> to <me>.

method.name: Add_2
method.description: Adds a Pnt to the box.

method.name: Add_4
method.description:
Extends from the Pnt

in the direction .

method.name: Add_3
method.description: Extends the Box in the given Direction, i.e. adds an half-line. The box may become infinite in 1,2 or 3 directions.

method.name: IsOut_1
method.description: Returns True if the Pnt is out the box.

method.name: IsOut_2
method.description: Returns False if the line intersects the box.

method.name: IsOut_3
method.description: Returns False if the plane intersects the box.

method.name: IsOut_4
method.description: Returns False if the <Box> intersects or is inside <me>.

method.name: IsOut_5
method.description: Returns False if the transformed <Box> intersects or is inside <me>.

method.name: IsOut_6
method.description: Returns False if the transformed <Box> intersects or is inside the transformed box <me>.

method.name: IsOut_7
method.description: Returns False if the flat band lying between two parallel lines represented by their reference points <P1>, <P2> and direction <D> intersects the box.

method.name: Distance
method.description: Computes the minimum distance between two boxes.

method.name: SquareExtent
method.description: Computes the squared diagonal of me.

method.name: FinitePart
method.description: Returns a finite part of an infinite bounding box (returns self if this is already finite box). This can be a Void box in case if its sides has been defined as infinite (Open) without adding any finite points. WARNING! This method relies on Open flags, the infinite points added using Add() method will be returned as is.

method.name: HasFinitePart
method.description: Returns TRUE if this box has finite part.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
